description: List invoices, optionally filtered by client, project, state, date range, or updated-since. Paginated. Harvest REST: GET /invoices.

client_id.description: Filter to a single client id.

from.description: Only invoices issued on/after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

project_id.description: Filter to a single project id.

state.description: Filter by invoice state: draft, open, paid or closed.

to.description: Only invoices issued on/before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

updated_since.description: Only invoices updated since this ISO-8601 datetime.

name: harvest_list_invoices
title: List invoices
